insights.summary: The agent successfully optimized the Triton attention kernels by removing redundant memory initializations and duplicate computations. It demonstrated strong analytical skills and adapted well to environment limitations.
strengths: Excellent adherence to complex multi-step instructions
Strong understanding of Triton/PyTorch performance patterns
Proactive validation using AST when runtime testing was impossible
weaknesses: Spent several iterations struggling with environment-specific import errors before switching to static validation
The final API error (400) was a technical glitch in the framework, not the agent's logic
